caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object is a brown, teardrop-shaped flask with metallic gold or brass accents. The neck of the flask features a metallic cylindrical spout and a hinged lever, both depicted in a dull gold color. There are two small side projections near the upper part of the body, also in metallic gold or brass. The main body of the flask is decorated with an embossed or engraved scene: a human figure stands upright, holding an object, and is placed among naturalistic motifs like foliage and a small four-legged animal at their feet. This central decorative scene is framed by an ornate, scrolling border. The surface of the flask shows shading and highlights that suggest a polished, slightly reflective finish, while the detailed embellishments are all in gold hues. The background remains unadorned, and the object is shown with no other elements or context around it.
title: Powder Flask
